title: Narmer Palette shows Egypt existed before reunification

tellings.quote: because the hallmark of the beginning of the dynastic period is known as the reunification of upper and lower Egypt as indicated by the Nar pallet or the meanis pallet.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast who has his own theory about the pyramids, points to the Narmer Palette, an ancient carved stone slab from Egypt. He says the start of the age of the pharaohs is marked by the "reunification" of Upper and Lower Egypt shown on the palette, and that the word means a united Egypt must have existed before. If true, it would push Egyptian civilization further back than the usual story.
